identity.statusNote: The seed URL https://snapseed.online does not resolve (DNS failure) and is not an official Google domain. Snapseed has no dedicated marketing website; its official presence is the Google Play and App Store listings.

freePlan.limits: Entirely free app, no ads, no subscription, no in-app purchases; all editing tools and filters are available from install.

keyLimits.en: All editing tools, filters and looks are available from install, with no ads, subscription or in-app purchases.

capabilities.en: Professional-grade mobile photo editing: selective adjustments (healing, brush, curves), RAW (DNG) editing, and non-destructive edit stacks.
A library of one-tap filters and looks alongside granular manual controls.

limitations.en: Mobile-only (Android/iOS); no desktop or web application.
No collaboration, cloud sync across devices, or team features, since it is a single-user consumer app with no account-based plan.

reason.en: Direct mobile photo-editing competitor with a comparable feature set, but Lightroom uses a freemium/subscription model versus Snapseed's fully free app.

unknowns: The seed website URL (snapseed.online) does not resolve and appears to be an unofficial/fan domain rather than Google's product; officialUrl was corrected to the Google Play listing during this pass, but the App Store URL was not separately verified.
No dedicated docs or changelog page exists for Snapseed; release history is only visible through app-store update notes, not checked here.
